parameters.formDescription: Triage every request in the inbox. One AI step per request proposes its lane, size, the two lane tests, a goal, a playbook, score parts and a reason. Urgent, fixed-date, low-confidence and flagged items wait for a person on the confirmation form. Started by hand only; nothing is sent to anyone.

parameters.query: select request_id, source, requester_role, title, body, requester_due_date::text as requester_due_date, requester_says_breaks, requester_says_harm, arrived_at from changedesk.inbox order by arrived_at, request_id;
select goal_id, title, description, active from changedesk.goals where active order by goal_id;
select key, value from changedesk.settings order by key;

parameters.jsCode:
// ===== n8n node: Stamp Start (run once for each item) =====
return { json: Object.assign({}, $json, { started_ms: Date.now() }) };

parameters.query: select run_id, calls, failed, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_cost_usd::float8 as total_cost_usd, cost_per_call_usd::float8 as cost_per_call_usd from changedesk.run_summary where run_id = $1;

parameters.jsCode:
// Done message
return [{ json: { title: "Nothing to triage", message: 'The inbox is empty: every request has been triaged.' } }];
